Bot.description: A generic, presentation-only agent. Its single job is to turn structured data another agent already holds into the right HXL card. It never fetches data and never answers the business question in prose — it composes the action input (a JSON spec) and renders the card. Kept as a DEDICATED agent so display logic never pollutes the reasoning of task agents. Today it renders a Ranked Table and a Next Steps card; add one action per card as the gallery grows.
Bot.label: UI Specialist
